justifications.durability: the landing rule that was wrong now has a guard that provably fires: restoring the file to e6b344f3 and dropping the first-parent and colon-subject requirement in _landed_in_window reddens tests/test_velocity_coordinator_cost.py::test_a_promotion_off_the_first_parent_does_not_land with a concrete assertion (1 == 0, exit 1) — mutation-control.log — and the census parity measurement is a second, external instrument. Two points are withheld because the refinement that closed the remaining gap carries no test that fires: with promotion_receipts restored from e6b344f3 and mutated back to the pre-repair whole-command search, the suite stays green at 8 passed (mutation-control-receipt.log), and the declared negative control reddens the pre-existing cache-read separation test instead of the code this repair changed.
justifications.evidence: the recorded measurement is now arithmetically sound and independently reproducible. Re-run in my own tree over the two artefacts (independent-parity-check.log, independent-exact-check.log): 52 of 52 sessions within 1%, and exactly equal rather than merely within tolerance on landed_nodes, assistant turns and all five token keys; totals 2182 landed nodes, 38699 assistant responses, 20179819699 cache-read tokens. The artefact carries a marker the pre-repair code could not have produced — 52 session rows where the earlier measurement listed 49 — so it is not a stale copy. The gate re-runs green in my hands at the reviewed head (13 passed, exit 0) with the module resolving from the reviewed tree. Three points are withheld: the comparison script's terminal sentinel is unconditional (measure_coordinator_cost.py:132 prints EXIT=0 whatever the counts, so the exit status is not evidence of anything and only the printed counts are), the reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite so the added-failure count is unmeasured, and the receipt-rule refinements that closed the last two residual sessions are guarded by no test that fires (see the second FINDING).
justifications.fit: velocity.py follows the module's own idiom — the section-description table extended in place, ratio() reuse, module-level roots — and the naming checks are clean on the lines this diff adds (no plan or stage label, no ticket reference, no changelog prose; the single case-sensitive hit is the RUN_ID regex literal describing the run-id shape). The module imports nothing from docs/; its only references there are git object paths it reads through the git CLI. Two points are withheld for a format finding: the reviewed head fails ruff format --check on reckon/velocity.py in exactly the lines this repair added, where the base and every earlier revision of the file are clean under the same config.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the section the goal names is implemented and now lands on the census's own count: reckon/velocity.py:968 coordinator_cost groups on node_definition.coordinator.runtime_session_id, reckon/velocity.py:1014 divides the session's assistant responses and tokens by the rows the landed rule admits, and rows without an identity enter an explicitly keyed unattributed bucket. One point is withheld for the committed-marker clause: velocity attributes the marker on a single snapshot source (record_source == "committed_primary_snapshot", reckon/velocity.py:962) where the census requires the committed ledger specifically, so a run known only from a committed run file with a promoted_revision would count in the section and not in the census. No such run appears in this window — the measured per-session landed counts are exactly equal for all 52 sessions — so the divergence is latent rather than observed.
justifications.scope_discipline: the whole diff 8ab4d4b8..e6b344f3 names five paths and every one is inside the declared write paths: reckon/velocity.py, tests/test_velocity_coordinator_cost.py, docs/evidence/archive/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity-landed.html, docs/plans/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity.html and the new PNG under docs/figures/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity/. The net diff deletes exactly one line in the whole range — the measure() signature the transcript_root kwarg extends. The repair round's document edits replace this node's own §3 prose only: the plan diff at 0b61cc5d touches no plan-* meta attribute and no section heading, and the archive edit is confined to the section this node authored, with no peer node's anchor removed.
